title: CHARM+: Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism
abstract: arXiv:2611.05906v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As sequence lengths continue to grow, distributed attention based on sequence parallel (e.g., Ring-Attention) has become a mainstream solution for large language models (LLMs). Nevertheless, inherent communication dependencies limit computation-communication overlap, reducing GPU utilization. Moreover, in cross-hardware (NUMA or node) architectures, due to imbalanced communication bandwidth, frequent communication synchronization will limit overall performance. Based on these insights, we propose CHARM+, Cross-Hardware Attention with Re-Merge Multistream Mechanism. We reorganize sequential communications into several levels and achieve intra-level parallelism and computation overlap. Furthermore, we decouple cross-hardware communication from intra-hardware communication, eliminating synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance. translated_title: CHARM+：基于重合并多流机制的跨硬件注意力
translated_abstract: 随着序列长度不断增长，基于序列并行的分布式注意力（如Ring-Attention）已成为大语言模型（LLMs）的主流解决方案。然而，固有的通信依赖性限制了计算与通信的重叠，降低了GPU利用率。此外，在跨硬件（NUMA或节点）架构中，由于通信带宽不均衡，频繁的通信同步会限制整体性能。基于这些洞察，我们提出了CHARM+（基于重合并多流机制的跨硬件注意力）。我们将顺序通信重组为多个层级，实现层级内的并行性和计算重叠。此外，我们将跨硬件通信与硬件内通信解耦，消除了由带宽不均衡引起的同步开销。前向和反向算法在多种硬件架构上进行了评估，并持续展现出优越的性能表现。
tldr: CHARM+通过将顺序通信重组为多个层级以实现层级内并行和计算与通信重叠，并将跨硬件通信与硬件内通信解耦以消除带宽不均衡导致的同步开销，从而显著提升跨硬件架构下分布式注意力的整体性能。
en_tdlr: CHARM+ enhances distributed attention by reorganizing sequential communications into multiple levels for intra-level parallelism and computation-communication overlap, and by decoupling cross-hardware from intra-hardware communication to eliminate synchronization overhead caused by bandwidth imbalance.
